messages:
kevin: Quick note 1: planning a rolling BMC firmware soft-flash across az3 GPU racks to resolve intermittent watchdog resets. Window: Mon 2026-04-12 02:30-04:30 UTC. Expect ~2-4 min host maintenance per rack.

marta: Are dedicated/reserved pools affected? We need to exclude enterprise racks.

kevin: Target: az3-general-edge-1 and az3-general-edge-2 (spot & burst). Dedicated-reserved racks are excluded. We'll route burst to az1 fallback.

sanjay: Historical impact: minor elevation in preemption counts while nodes re-registered. Suggest pre-warm standby capacity.

liz: Can we pre-warm ten nodes and run kvseed? Also ensure autoscaler cap at 10%.

netops-bot: BGP pref update ready for az1 fallback. Will apply route preference during window.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket MO-2420 created - https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2420

kevin: Preflight commands:
```bash
infra/bmc-flash --racks az3-rack-[01..10] --stagger 10m --dry-run
python infra/kvseed.py --pool az3-general-edge-1 --seed 0.7 --timeout 1200
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.1}}'
```

marta: Canary: 4 racks in us-west1 to verify re-registration and no task-shed. Abort if requeue rates > 1% or p99 latency delta > 25ms.

liz: Ops timeline:
- 02:30 start canary (us-west1 4 racks)
- 03:00 validate + 15m buffer
- 03:30 begin az3 stagger (10m per rack overlapping 2 racks)
- 04:15 final checks
- 04:30 close window

kevin: Cost note: estimate extra hosted token usage ~60k tokens -> ~$690 at $0.0115/token. Posting to #finance.

sanjay: Add a guard: pause large quantization jobs and disable automated canaries for eval pipeline to avoid false alarms.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MO-2420 will start Mon 2026-04-12 02:30 UTC. Canary automation will trigger at T-60m.

marta: OK. I'll send customer advisory targeted to burst pool owners and lock autoscaler.

kevin: I'll coordinate with hardware vendor for flash windows and keep firmware rollback ready.

liz: All set from my side. :thumbsup:
